tasks.description: Maps each section of the security policy documents to the controls it cites in the control catalog. Use when asked for a policy-to-control mapping of a policy set.
tasks.intent: Map policy sections to catalog controls and flag unknown control references.

tasks.description: Finds catalog controls that no policy cites and reports coverage by domain. Use when asked which controls are not covered by any policy.
tasks.intent: List controls in the catalog that no policy cites, with coverage.

tasks.description: Drafts audit evidence requests for controls that policies cite, grouped by evidence owner. Use when asked for an evidence request list for an audit.
tasks.intent: Draft per-owner evidence requests for policy-cited controls.
